BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Rule, Simmons, Lekanoff, Shewmake, Ormsby, and Pollet

BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Health Care & Wellness.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning health coverage for wraparound services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to health coverage for wraparound services; adding a new section to chapter 41.05 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 48.43 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 41.05 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) A health plan offered to public employees and their covered dependents under this chapter issued or renewed on or after January 1, 2022, must provide coverage for wraparound services for persons who are under 21 years of age.
(b) Counseling, including individual, family, group, youth, and vocational counseling;
(d) Education and special education services, including tutoring;
(e) Family support, independent living supports, self-help, or support groups;
(f) Psychiatric consultation and community-based in-patient psychiatric care;

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 2. A new section is added to chapter 48.43 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) For health plans issued or renewed on or after January 1, 2022, a health carrier must provide coverage for wraparound services for persons who are under 21 years of age.
(b) Counseling, including individual, family, group, youth, and vocational counseling;
(d) Education and special education services, including tutoring;
(e) Family support, independent living supports, self-help, or support groups;
(f) Psychiatric consultation and community-based in-patient psychiatric care;
